name: CorrespondenceMetadata
description: Letters and letter calendars, with one entry per letter giving its sender, recipient, date and a short summary.

contains_no_content_of_requested_type.description: Set to true if the input text contains no letters or letter descriptions. Otherwise, set to false.

sender.description: The name of the sender, as written. Use null if unknown.

recipient.description: The name of the recipient, as written. Use null if unknown.

date.description: The date of the letter, as written. Use null if the source gives no date.

place.description: The place from which the letter was sent. Use null if not stated.

language.description: The language of the letter. Use null if not stated.

summary.description: A one- or two-sentence summary of the content of the letter, in English.

source_page.description: The page or folio on which the letter or its description appears. Use null if not identifiable.

notes.description: Remarks about the letter, such as enclosures, damage or an uncertain reading. Use null if there are none.
